interactions.note: Orrin-blockers must not be combined with Caloradine.
Use together only with specialist advice, and review for dizziness.

renal.note: Halve the dose when eGFR is 30 to 59.

hepatic.note: Monitor closely in moderate liver disease.

interactions.note: Orrin-blockers must not be combined with Mendel solution.

labs.note: Avoid when potassium is above 5.5 mmol/L.
Avoid when platelets are below 100 x10^9/L.
Check with a haematologist when INR is above 1.5.
